display.title: Chazak, Chazak, V'nis'chazek: Finishing Sefer Bereishis
display.summary_short: Why everyone in shul calls out 'Chazak, Chazak, V'nis'chazek' on the Shabbos of Parshas Vayechi, when we finish reading Sefer Bereishis.
display.summary_long: A short talk from the Tzivos Hashem radio show. Uncle Yossi invites children to shul this Shabbos for something special: usually we speak softly in shul out of respect, but this Shabbos everyone will call out three words at the top of their voices, 'Chazak, Chazak, V'nis'chazek', asking Hashem for strength to learn more Torah and do more mitzvos. He explains why: since Simchas Torah we have read one sedra each week, and this Shabbos, Parshas Vayechi, completes the first Chumash, Bereishis; at Mincha we begin Shemos. He encourages children to bring relatives and friends to share the simcha, and promises that Hashem will give strength to all who call out.
display.lesson: Celebrate finishing a part of the Torah, and ask Hashem for strength to learn and do even more.

date.note: 'This coming Shabbos' is Parshas Vayechi; episode 411 states 12 Teves.
